question: For acceptance item 3 ('input token count includes cache-creation tokens'): should the ledger keep ADR-012's separate counters (input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens), with cache-creation recorded as cache_write_tokens and total input = their sum, or should the input_tokens field itself include cache-creation tokens for third-party rows?
reason: mctl-api prices cache_write_tokens separately, so an inclusive input_tokens would double-count and break column comparability with Anthropic rows. The proposal assumes the separate-counters reading.

options: Keep separate counters; cache_write_tokens carries cache-creation (proposal default)
Make input_tokens inclusive of cache-creation for third-party rows only
